pages.text: $(italic)No tradeoffs. No standout strengths. The Human is the most flexible race — every class and playstyle is equally viable.$()$(br2)$(bold)Versatile$() — Gain +1 bonus to whichever skill tree you invest in most (evaluated every 30 min). Rewards focused builds.

pages.title: Traits (cont.)
pages.text: $(bold)Quick Learner$() — +15% XP gained from all sources. Compounds significantly over long play sessions.$(br2)$(bold)Adaptable$() — Can change secondary race trait every 24 IRL hours via Class Altar (minor toggle only).$(br2)$(bold)Next: pair it with any class — Wanderer if you're undecided: $(l:icraft:welcome/class_guide)Pick Your Origin, Race & Class$(/l).$()
